work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. The preamble and the printed paragraph sequence run continuously through the grant, exhortation, executors and derogation to the terminal transumpt paragraph, printed again as §6 at 94914; this repeated source number is preserved. Retain source note 94433 and historical notes 94561, 94635, 94637, 94693, 94739–94742, 94849 and 94905. Own dating clause 94927–94929 and printed date 94931 precede LXIII 94934.
